params.name: organization_id
params.description: ID of the organization. Note: This value is a set of numeric characters.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to be fetched. Default value is 1.

params.name: per_page
params.description: Number of records to be fetched per page. Default value is 200.

params.name: sort_column
params.description: Column used to sort the list. Allowed values are date, created_time, and last_modified_time.

params.name: sort_order
params.description: Sort order. Allowed values are A for ascending and D for descending.

params.name: filter_by
params.description: Filter using built-in views. Max-length 100. Examples: TransferDate.All, TransferDate.ThisMonth, TransferStatus.InTransit, TransferStatus.Transferred, MissingAdvancedTrackingDetails.

params.name: search_text
params.description: Search text applied across supported columns for the list.

params.name: status
params.description: Filter by transfer order status. Allowed values are in_transit, transferred, partially_transferred, draft, pending_approval, approved, and void.

params.name: item_id
params.description: Filter by item ID.

params.name: item_name
params.description: Filter by item name.

params.name: project_id
params.description: Filter by project ID.

params.name: from_warehouse_id
params.description: Filter by source warehouse ID.

params.name: from_warehouse_name
params.description: Filter by source warehouse name.

params.name: to_warehouse_id
params.description: Filter by destination warehouse ID.

params.name: to_warehouse_name
params.description: Filter by destination warehouse name.

params.name: from_location_id
params.description: Filter by source location ID.

params.name: from_location_name
params.description: Filter by source location name.

params.name: to_location_id
params.description: Filter by destination location ID.

params.name: to_location_name
params.description: Filter by destination location name.

params.name: customview_id
params.description: Custom view ID to apply.

params.name: serial_number
params.description: Filter by serial number.

params.name: transfer_order_number
params.description: Filter by transfer order number.

params.name: transfer_order_number_startswith
params.description: Filter by transfer order numbers that start with the given value.

params.name: transfer_order_number_contains
params.description: Filter by transfer order numbers that contain the given value.

params.name: reason
params.description: Filter by reason text (same family of search operators as transfer order number).

params.name: reference_number_contains
params.description: Filter by reference number contains.

params.name: date
params.description: Filter by exact transfer date. Format yyyy-mm-dd.

params.name: date_start
params.description: Filter from this date (inclusive). Format yyyy-mm-dd.

params.name: date_end
params.description: Filter up to this date (inclusive). Format yyyy-mm-dd.

params.name: date_before
params.description: Filter by dates before this date. Format yyyy-mm-dd.

params.name: date_after
params.description: Filter by dates after this date. Format yyyy-mm-dd.

params.name: tracking_number
params.description: Filter by tracking number.
